'''Anavaisk''' is a historic center in the [[Duchy of Ledostrov]].

== Early Role ==

Ledostrov's founding tradition begins with the [[Count of Anavaisk]], who was crowned duke by twenty-six nobles in 840. The source later calls Anavaisk the old, pre-Accords capital.

== Later Importance ==

The [[Anavaisk-Novoanov Accords]] preserved Anavaisk in the constitutional memory of the duchy even after [[Novoanov]] became the central Duma city. Under [[Reznikoff of Ledostrov]], the old source says Reznikoff funded and occupied Reznikoff Palace in Anavaisk, a later sign that hereditary succession might return.

== Source Limits ==

Reznikoff Palace and the succession concerns are described in 2003-era source wording. They are preserved as later trajectory notes, not hard 1994 political outcomes.
